subject: Post-call recap + single-slot ask (short hold) - Aurora Health
snippet: Missed deep-dive; offering a single tightly-held slot and asking for quick confirmation. Includes discovery notes and a short hold policy.
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Derek Murray <derek.murray@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + single-slot ask (short hold) - Aurora Health

Hi Derek —

Thanks for hopping on earlier. Quick recap from our side and a proposed path to get the deep-dive back on calendar: 

- Recap (5 bullets):
  * Current priority: reduce inference cost for clinical summarization pipelines.
  * Key constraint: FHIR PHI handling; needs private deployment or strong KMS controls.
  * Desired metrics: sub-200ms median token latency, <40ms p50 for short prompts.
  * Stakeholders: you (product), Aaron (engineering lead, TBD), IT/security will review controls.
  * Next step: 45m technical deep-dive (runtime + deployment options).

We had a deep-dive scheduled for today that looks like it conflicted on your end — totally understand. To avoid the slot slipping again, can we do one tightly-held option instead of open-ended choices? I can hold the single slot below for 24 hours but will release it if not confirmed to avoid blocking eng time.

- Single tightly-held option:
  * Wednesday 4 Aug 2026, 09:30 AM PT / 12:30 PM ET — 45 minutes

If that works, reply with "Confirm: Wed 8/4 09:30 PT" and I will send a calendar invite and attach a 1-page tech pre-read. If that's not possible, reply with one alternative window (we'll try to accommodate). Please try to include Aaron or another engineering attendee — we want to get into runtime details and quantization tradeoffs.

Attachments: 2026-07-28_Aurora-discovery-notes.pdf (summary), redwood-demo-prep-checklist.xlsx (what we'll demo)

Quick ask: please confirm within 24 hours so I can hold eng time. If I don't hear back, I'll open the calendar.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com

From: Derek Murray <derek.murray@aurorahealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 15:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + single-slot ask (short hold) - Aurora Health

Vanessa —

Really sorry about today; an unexpected leadership all-hands pulled me offline. Appreciate the concise recap. I can do Tue 3 Aug in the afternoon or Thu 5 Aug mid-morning — Wed morning is tight for me. Also, Aaron (our eng lead) is traveling until Friday, so he won't be able to make early-August slots.

Would it be possible to do Thu 5 Aug at 11:00 AM PT instead? If Aaron can't make it, I can bring our senior infra PM and we can still evaluate the architecture decisions from a product/integration perspective.

Apologies again — please advise if Thu 5th is workable.

Thanks,
Derek
Senior Product Manager | Aurora Health
derek.murray@aurorahealth.com

Thanks for the quick reply, Derek — totally understand about travel and the leadership call. Two quick notes:

1) Because Aaron won't be available until after Friday, our best path to keep momentum is to hold a single tactical session focused on architecture and integration options (we'll capture detailed notes so Aaron can review asynchronously).

2) I can do Thu 5 Aug 11:00 AM PT but engineering on our side is already booked then. To keep this moving without a heavy lift from your side, I'm going to offer a single alternate:

  * Confirmed option (short hold): Wednesday 4 Aug 09:30 AM PT — I will hold for 6 business hours from the time you confirm. If you prefer Thu 5 Aug 11:00 AM PT we can do that but I need firm confirmation by EOD tomorrow because that's when our lead infra engineer's slot opens up.

If you want Thu 5th and can confirm by EOD tomorrow, reply "Confirm: Thu 8/5 11:00 PT" and I'll coordinate to free up eng time. Otherwise, replying "Confirm: Wed 8/4 09:30 PT" will lock the 4th immediately and I will send the invite + 1-page pre-read.

Calendar invite (tentative hold): https://calendly.com/redwood/aurora-deep-dive?invite=abc123
Pre-read (short): https://drive.redwood.com/s/aurora-tech-pre-read

Thanks again — trying to keep this low-friction.

—Vanessa
